/** 🧱️ Presentation vocabulary: how strongly a participant is emphasised, the transition into a slide, the participant itself, the metadata of an arrangement, the dispositions that place and style a participant and the language kinds a presentation is written in.
 *
 * @see ../🟦️.ts — the package entry that publishes this module
 */

/** 🎭️ Presentation embodiments: the text morph roots and every embodiment a participant takes — text, figure, video, pdf, iframe, markdown, json, bullets, authors and affiliations — with the media scroll origin and the morph labels of the affiliation steps.
 *
 * @see ../🧱️vocabulary/🟦️.ts — emphasis and dispositions
 * @see ../🟦️.ts — the package entry that publishes this module
 */

/** 🔭️ Presentation scope: the participants and embodiments an artifact scope holds and the resolution scope built from thoughts.
 *
 * @see ../🎭️embodiments/🟦️.ts — the embodiments a scope holds
 * @see ../🟦️.ts — the package entry that publishes this module
 */

/** 🎞️ Presentation structure: arrangements, slides, thoughts, sequences, chapters and the presentation, and the scope an arrangement resolves in.
 *
 * @see ../🔭️scope/🟦️.ts — the scopes the structure resolves in
 * @see ../🟦️.ts — the package entry that publishes this module
 */

/** 🧩️ Presentation tiles: tiling figures, splitting a figure grid into tiles and the tile play that seeds, moves and resizes tile drafts and builds their morph prompt.
 *
 * @see ../🎭️embodiments/🟦️.ts — the figure embodiment
 * @see ../🧱️vocabulary/🟦️.ts — the dispositions
 * @see ../🟦️.ts — the package entry that publishes this module
 */

/** 📐️ Presentation resolution: resolved dispositions with their bounds and centring, the expansion of thoughts into render slides and the resolution of embodiments and arrangements in a scope.
 *
 * @see ../🎞️structure/🟦️.ts — thoughts, slides and arrangements
 * @see ../🔭️scope/🟦️.ts — the resolution scope
 * @see ../🟦️.ts — the package entry that publishes this module
 */

/** 🔖️ Presentation bookmarks: the query parameters and hash of a slide url, the bookmark names of entities and the collection of every slide of a presentation.
 *
 * @see ../📐️resolution/🟦️.ts — the expansion into slides
 * @see ../🟦️.ts — the package entry that publishes this module
 */

/** 📂️ Presentation slide files: the types and file paths of slide and thought files, the assembly of thoughts and chapters from them and the intro specification a thought file may carry.
 *
 * @see ../🎞️structure/🟦️.ts — the structure assembled
 * @see ../🔭️scope/🟦️.ts — the artifact scope merged
 * @see ../🟦️.ts — the package entry that publishes this module
 */

/** 🎬️ Presentation intro: the template that turns title, description, goal, authors and affiliations into the slides and thought file of an introduction.
 *
 * @see ../📂️slide-files/🟦️.ts — the slide files the intro writes
 * @see ../🟦️.ts — the package entry that publishes this module
 */

/** 🧭️ Presentation slide glob: loading a whole presentation from a glob of slide modules and thought files.
 *
 * @see ../📂️slide-files/🟦️.ts — the slide files
 * @see ../🎬️intro/🟦️.ts — the intro thought files that expand to slide modules
 * @see ../🟦️.ts — the package entry that publishes this module
 */

/** 🔄️ Presentation analogy and play: the analogy template between a source and a target and the definitions of the play apps.
 *
 * @see ../🎞️structure/🟦️.ts — the structure an analogy builds
 * @see ../🟦️.ts — the package entry that publishes this module
 */
